project_name: KAEL - Platforma de Intermediación de Alquiler de Barcos

theme_strategy.default_mode: Light Editorial Warm Cream with Dynamic VIP Midnight Blue & Gold Tier Switching

display_serif.usage: H1 Hero Headlines, Section Titles, VIP Cards Headings, Featured Boat Names

cinematic_loading_intro.description: Custom Sailboat SVG Floating Intro with dynamic loading speed acceleration
cinematic_loading_intro.behavior: Displays once per session (check sessionStorage). While loading assets/data, sailboat floats gracefully in waves at slow speed (2.5s cycle). When loaded, sailboat accelerates forward (0.6s exit animation with wave wake particles) and dissolves into main page.
cinematic_loading_intro.visuals: Minimalist geometric sailboat logomark in #366A8B with glowing gold water reflection, progress ring, and elegant text 'KAEL • Náutica de Excepción'.

kinetic_hero_section.description: Editorial Hero section with masked line-by-line headline reveal, filter quick search, and interactive boat background carousel.
kinetic_hero_section.headline_es: Descubre la Libertad de Navegar las Mejoress Calas del Mediterráneo y el Caribe

3d_boat_carousel_la_rueda.description: Rebuilt and enhanced 3D rotating boat carousel ('La Rueda de Embarcaciones') with perspective rotation, drag controls, company grouping, and VIP tier glow.
3d_boat_carousel_la_rueda.tech_stack: Framer Motion 3D / CSS 3D Transforms with perspective, touch drag, and arrow navigation.
3d_boat_carousel_la_rueda.behavior: 3D cylindrical ring showing boats grouped by verified nautical company. Clicking a boat rotates it to center stage with depth-of-field scaling and detailed floating badge.
3d_boat_carousel_la_rueda.vip_enhancement: When a VIP/Premium company boat is centered, the wheel backdrop seamlessly shifts to Midnight Blue & Gold aura with glowing particle trails.

vip_tier_switching_system.description: Dynamic visual switch when viewing or filtering Premium Company Boats vs Standard Company Boats.
vip_tier_switching_system.vip_style_rules: Card background transforms to Midnight Blue (#0A1128), text turns crisp off-white (#F7F5F0), borders shimmer in Metallic Gold (#D4AF37), price badge gets a gold gradient pill, and a 'VIP Partner' crowned badge is rendered.
vip_tier_switching_system.animation: Glow shimmer effect on hover with subtle gold shadow blur (`shadow-[0_10px_30px_rgba(212,175,55,0.18)]`).
vip_tier_switching_system.toggle_selector: Allow user to filter 'Solo Empresas VIP' or toggle VIP view mode on catalog and carousel.

catalog_and_filter_system.description: Comprehensive Boat Catalog with real-time filtering, layout view switches (Grid vs Map/3D Wheel), and dynamic VIP sorting.
filters: Tipo de Barco (Yate, Catamarán, Velero, Lancha, Superyate)

boat_detail_page_and_modal.description: Full-featured Boat Detail view showcasing high-res image gallery, technical specs, company verifications, included services, and Availability Request Form.
features: Solicitud de Disponibilidad Form (no direct payment)

availability_request_form.description: No-online-payment inquiry form sending requests directly to backend API (`/api/requests` or `/api/disponibilidad`).
availability_request_form.toast_notification: Sonner toast notification on success with confirmation code

layout_and_spacing.bento_grid_mode: MODE A: TETRIS GRID for Marketing showcases and VIP highlights. Asymmetric 12-column grid with gap-8 to gap-12.

hero_backgrounds.description: Velero de lujo en cala turquesa de Ibiza
Vista aérea de Yate de Lujo en mar calmo
Superyate velero con tres mastiles en aguas cristalinas

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements (buttons, links, search inputs, filters, tabs, modal triggers, form controls) and key metrics MUST include explicit data-testid attributes in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Verify and import Google Fonts ('Fraunces' and 'Hanken Grotesk') in public/index.html or src/index.css.
Create the LoadingIntro component in src/components/LoadingIntro.jsx with sessionStorage persistence and smooth speed acceleration when resources are ready.
Rebuild 'La Rueda' (3D Carousel) in src/components/BoatWheel3D.jsx with 3D perspective rotation, company badges, drag support, and VIP background aura shift.
Implement VIP styling switch logic (Midnight Blue #0A1128 + Gold #D4AF37) for premium company cards and sections.
Ensure all API form submissions for availability requests call POST /api/requests and trigger Sonner toast notifications.
Strictly follow JavaScript React conventions (.js and .jsx files, direct Tailwind class names, Sonner toast notifications).
